g.text: Minimum CPU Required by P99 SLO
S/C symmetric BUD + Sleep | Client container: 8 vCPU | Server container: 8 vCPU | Combined quota: 16 vCPU

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #444444

g.text: Selection rule: minimize total CPU subject to attainment ≥ 99.5% and measured P99 ≤ budget. Each step begins at an observed candidate center; duplicate GQM centers are two-run means.

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #444444

g.text: CPU metric: sum of thread-level process CPU across client and server. Socket is a system-level reference, not a GQM IRQ measurement; other candidates are single-run.
